WITH radar_base AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT radarentry."key" AS "key", radarentry.seen AS seen, CASE WHEN (graphmetric.event IS NOT NULL) THEN ? ELSE ? END AS analyzed 
FROM radarentry LEFT OUTER JOIN graphmetric ON graphmetric.event = radarentry."key" 
WHERE radarentry."key" IN (SELECT event.event_key 
FROM event 
WHERE (event.event_key NOT IN (SELECT eventstate.event_key 
FROM eventstate 
WHERE eventstate.merged_into IS NOT NULL)))), 
radar_articles AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT articleeventlink.article_key AS article_key 
FROM articleeventlink 
WHERE articleeventlink.event_key IN (SELECT radar_base."key" 
FROM radar_base)), 
radar_observed AS 
(SELECT DISTINCT collectedobservation.article_key AS article_key, collectedobservation.scope_id AS scope_id 
FROM collectedobservation 
WHERE collectedobservation.article_key IN (SELECT radar_articles.article_key 
FROM radar_articles)), 
radar_recorded_paths AS 
(SELECT taskrecord.task_id AS scope_id, CASE WHEN (json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(taskrecord.profile_json) THEN taskrecord.profile_json ELSE '{}' END, '$.' || ?) IN (?, ?, ?, ?)) THEN json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(taskrecord.profile_json) THEN taskrecord.profile_json ELSE '{}' END, '$.' || ?) ELSE ? END AS provider 
FROM taskrecord 
WHERE taskrecord.task_id IN (SELECT radar_observed.scope_id 
FROM radar_observed) AND (json_type(CASE WHEN json_valid(taskrecord.profile_json) THEN taskrecord.profile_json ELSE '{}' END, '$.' || ?) = 'text') = 1 AND (json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(taskrecord.profile_json) THEN taskrecord.profile_json ELSE '{}' END, '$.' || ?) NOT IN (?, ?)) UNION ALL SELECT runrecord.run_key AS scope_id, CASE WHEN (json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(runrecord.stats_json) THEN runrecord.stats_json ELSE '{}' END, '$.' || ?) IN (?, ?, ?, ?)) THEN json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(runrecord.stats_json) THEN runrecord.stats_json ELSE '{}' END, '$.' || ?) ELSE ? END AS provider 
FROM runrecord 
WHERE runrecord.run_key IN (SELECT radar_observed.scope_id 
FROM radar_observed) AND (json_type(CASE WHEN json_valid(runrecord.stats_json) THEN runrecord.stats_json ELSE '{}' END, '$.' || ?) = 'text') = 1 AND (json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(runrecord.stats_json) THEN runrecord.stats_json ELSE '{}' END, '$.' || ?) NOT IN (?, ?))), 
radar_observation_flags AS 
(SELECT radar_observed.article_key AS article_key, count(*) AS valid, max(CASE WHEN (radar_recorded_paths.provider = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS gkg, max(CASE WHEN (radar_recorded_paths.provider = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS gdelt, max(CASE WHEN (radar_recorded_paths.provider = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS worldnewsapi, max(CASE WHEN (radar_recorded_paths.provider = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS mock, max(CASE WHEN (radar_recorded_paths.provider = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS other 
FROM radar_observed JOIN radar_recorded_paths ON radar_recorded_paths.scope_id = radar_observed.scope_id GROUP BY radar_observed.article_key), 
radar_provider_flags AS 
(SELECT articleeventlink.event_key AS event_key, max(CASE WHEN (article.provider = ? OR coalesce(radar_observation_flags.gkg, ?) = ? OR gkgsource.article_key IS NOT NULL) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS p_gkg, max(CASE WHEN (article.provider = ? OR coalesce(radar_observation_flags.gdelt, ?) = ? OR gdeltdiscovery.article_key IS NOT NULL AND gkgsource.article_key IS NULL) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS p_gdelt, max(CASE WHEN (article.provider = ? OR coalesce(radar_observation_flags.worldnewsapi, ?) = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS p_worldnewsapi, max(CASE WHEN (article.provider = ? OR coalesce(radar_observation_flags.mock, ?) = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS p_mock, max(CASE WHEN ((article.provider NOT IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)) OR coalesce(radar_observation_flags.other, ?) = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS p_other, max(CASE WHEN ((article.provider IS NULL OR article.provider IN (?, ?)) AND gkgsource.article_key IS NULL AND gdeltdiscovery.article_key IS NULL AND coalesce(radar_observation_flags.valid, ?) = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS p_unknown 
FROM articleeventlink JOIN article ON article.article_key = articleeventlink.article_key LEFT OUTER JOIN gkgsource ON gkgsource.article_key = article.article_key LEFT OUTER JOIN gdeltdiscovery ON gdeltdiscovery.article_key = article.article_key LEFT OUTER JOIN radar_observation_flags ON radar_observation_flags.article_key = article.article_key 
WHERE articleeventlink.event_key IN (SELECT radar_base."key" 
FROM radar_base) GROUP BY articleeventlink.event_key), 
radar_latest AS 
(SELECT radar_articles.article_key AS article_key, (SELECT articleversion.id 
FROM articleversion 
WHERE articleversion.article_key = radar_articles.article_key ORDER BY articleversion.id DESC
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?) AS version_id 
FROM radar_articles), 
radar_channel_flags AS 
(SELECT articleeventlink.event_key AS event_key, max(CASE WHEN (json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(textmention.data) THEN textmention.data ELSE '{}' END, '$.' || ?) IN (?, ?, ?)) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS c_diplomacy, max(CASE WHEN (json_extract(CASE WHEN json_valid(textmention.data) THEN textmention.data ELSE '{}' END, '$.' || ?) IN (?)) THEN ? ELSE ? END) AS c_conflict 
FROM articleeventlink JOIN radar_latest ON radar_latest.article_key = articleeventlink.article_key JOIN textmention ON textmention.version_id = radar_latest.version_id AND textmention.article = radar_latest.article_key LEFT OUTER JOIN mentionreview ON mentionreview.id = textmention.id 
WHERE articleeventlink.event_key IN (SELECT radar_base."key" 
FROM radar_base) AND (mentionreview.id IS NULL OR mentionreview.decision != ?) GROUP BY articleeventlink.event_key), 
radar_facts AS MATERIALIZED 
(SELECT radar_base."key" AS "key", radar_base.seen AS seen, radar_base.analyzed AS analyzed, coalesce(radar_provider_flags.p_gkg, ?) AS p_gkg, coalesce(radar_provider_flags.p_gdelt, ?) AS p_other, coalesce(radar_provider_flags.p_unknown, ?) AS p_unknown, coalesce(radar_channel_flags.c_diplomacy, ?) AS c_diplomacy, coalesce(radar_channel_flags.c_conflict, ?) AS c_conflict 
FROM radar_base LEFT OUTER JOIN radar_provider_flags ON radar_provider_flags.event_key = radar_base."key" LEFT OUTER JOIN radar_channel_flags ON radar_channel_flags.event_key = radar_base."key"), 
radar_totals AS

ELSE ? END), ?) AS c_all_all, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (? = 1 AND radar_facts.seen >= ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END), ?) AS c_all_recent, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (radar_facts.c_diplomacy = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? AS c_diplomacy_recent, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (radar_facts.c_conflict = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END), ?) AS c_conflict_all, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (radar_facts.c_conflict = ? AND radar_facts.seen >= ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END), ?) AS c_conflict_recent, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN ? THEN ? ELSE ? END), ?) AS p_all_all, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (? = 1 AND radar_facts.seen >= ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END), ?) AS p_all_recent, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (radar_facts.p_gkg = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END), ?) AS p_gkg_all, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (radar_facts.p_gkg = ? AND radar_facts.seen >= ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END), ?) AS p_gkg_recent, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (radar_facts.p_gdelt = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END), ?) AS p_gdelt_all, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (radar_facts.p_gdelt = ? AND radar_facts.seen >= ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END), ?) AS p_gdelt_recent, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (radar_facts.p_worldnewsapi = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END), ?) AS p_worldnewsapi_all, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (radar_facts.p_worldnewsapi = ? AND radar_facts.seen >= ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END), ?) AS p_worldnewsapi_recent, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (radar_facts.p_mock = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END), ?) AS p_mock_all, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (radar_facts.p_mock = ? AND radar_facts.seen >= ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END), ?) AS p_mock_recent, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (radar_facts.p_other = ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END), ?) AS p_other_all, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (radar_facts.p_other = ? AND radar_facts.seen >= ?) THEN ? ELSE ? END), ?) AS p_other_recent, coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN (radar_facts.p_unknown = ?) THEN ?
